text: alex: Quick presales ask from BigFin — they want an EU-only POC (6 weeks). Need short answers for RFP + SOW by EOD tomorrow: 1) Can we ensure tenant traffic (compute + egress) stays in EU for hosted? 2) Full sub-processor list for EU region (infra, CDN, logging, analytics)? 3) BYOK / KMS options and whether keys can be restricted to EU KMS only for the POC? 4) Rough pricing delta for pinning to EU (hosted pin vs reserved dedicated) so we can include in SOW? 5) What happens if EU capacity is saturated — fail/reject or fallback to other region?
followup: maria: @alex short answers to start: 1) Yes — we support tenant pinning for EU in hosted via region preference + routing policies. 2) Subprocessors: primary infra is GCP (europe-west1/2), CDN partner FastEdge (EU POPs), metrics/logging on Datadog EU cluster. I can produce a signed subprocessor list. 3) BYOK: Hosted BYOK for EU-only control plane is limited; BYOK is fully supported on Dedicated and Private. For hosted customers we can route KMS calls to EU KMS for some cases but full hosted BYOK needs SOC/legal signoff. 4) Pricing (very rough): Dedicated reserved EU ≈ +30% vs global reserved (depends on GPU type), Hosted EU-pin add-on ≈ +15% per-token premium (egress & regional infra). I'll confirm exact numbers with infra. 5) Fallback: configurable — strict (reject requests) or soft (failover to nearest compatible region). Default behavior is soft failover unless customer requests strict rejection.
infra_note:
sam: infra details — endpoints are api.eu.redwood.ai for EU-pinned tenants, egress is kept in eu-west1/2. Subprocessors we call out: GCP (eu-west1), FastEdge CDN (EU POPs), Datadog EU, Sentry EU. Example tenant pin config (for ops page): ```json
{
  "tenant_id": "T-123",
  "region_pin": "eu",
  "fallback": "reject"
}
``` Note: setting fallback=reject returns 503 when capacity exceeded. Also, egress cost placeholder: $0.08/GB — varies by exact region and CDN usage.
legal_note: rowan: Legal: we can provide the EU subprocessors attestation and standard DPA; hosted BYOK is exceptional and will need SOC/Legal approval. If BigFin requires absolutely no cross-border telemetry, we need a custom addendum (could delay timeline). I'll open subprocessors ticked and start review.
next_steps: maria: I'll assemble a 1-pager + SOW draft and include the subprocessors list. @sam please confirm the +30% / +15% estimates and supply a short token-cost delta table for 250 qps / 60 tokens avg and peak 600 qps. Alex — confirm whether they want strict reject or soft failover for the POC. presales-bot: SOW template created at /docs/presales/eu-poc-sow-v2.md (assigned to maria).
final: alex: They expect ~250 qps steady, 60 tokens/req avg, peaks to 600 qps. Include both reserved capacity quote and hosted pin quote (worst-case included). They also flagged security questionnaire Q12 for subprocessors by region — rowan pls prioritize. Need assembled doc by COB tomorrow. Thanks! :thumbsup:
